name: m
description: The Power Query M language, agent-native. Every library function exported from the engine's own #shared, with its signature, parameter types, return type and the hosts that have it (Power BI Desktop, Excel, Dataflows Gen2); query folding and what breaks it; writing and documenting custom functions; and iteration with List.Generate, List.Accumulate and buffering. Annotated with field notes measured in a runnable lab. Not modeling or TMDL - that is data-goblin's power-query skill.
